name: @realitycollective/webxr-uiextensions
description: Engine-free core of the Reality Collective UI Extensions: windowing, docking, layout regions, hand menus, follow and placement rules, hover, scroll and cursor rules, control models for WebXR spatial UI, and the panel side of the one-pointer-per-hand decision shared with the Interactions family - driven through platform-adapter interfaces. Pair with an engine adapter: @realitycollective/iwsdk-uiextensions (Meta IWSDK), @realitycollective/threejs-uiextensions (plain three.js), @realitycollective/xrblocks-uiextensions (Google XR Blocks) or @realitycollective/native-uiextensions (native apps).
author: Reality Collective
